rule_title: TTP 1003.001 - LSASS Dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump (Lsassy / LOLBin)
description: Detects the comsvcs.dll MiniDump technique used by Lsassy and other tools to dump lsass memory without a dedicated external binary. The pattern is: powershell.exe launching rundll32.exe to call comsvcs.dll MiniDump against lsass, writing the dump to a temp path. This technique is a LOLBin (Living Off the Land Binary) approach — it uses only Windows-signed binaries, making it harder to detect via process image blocklisting. The combination of comsvcs.dll, MiniDump, and Get-Process lsass in the same command line is the high-fidelity indicator.
